verses.geez: ወእምዝ፡ ሶበ፡ አርመሙ፡ እልክቱ፡ ዕደው፡ እለ፡ ዓውደ፡ እንግልጋ፡ ይቤሉ፡ ሆሎፎርኒስ፡ መልአከ፡ ኃይሉ፡ ለአሶር፡ ለአክዮር፡ በቅድመ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሕዝበ፡ ኢሎፍሊ፡ ወኀበ፡ ኵሉ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሞአብ።
verses.translation: And when the tumult of men that were about the council was ceased, Holofernes the chief captain of the army of Assur said unto Achior and all the Moabites before all the company of other nations,

translations.lxx: And when the tumult of men that were about the council was ceased, Holofernes the chief captain of the army of Assur said unto Achior and all the Moabites before all the company of other nations,
translations.ron: Şi după ce s-a potolit zarva bărbaţilor care stăteau în jur la sfat, Olofern, căpetenia armatei asiriene, a zis lui Ahior, înaintea întregii mulţimi de străini şi de Amoniţi:

verses.geez: ገባዒሁ፡ ለኤፍሬም፡ ከመ፡ ትትነበይ፡ ለነ፡ ዮም፡ ወትብለነ፡ ኢትፅብዕዎሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ እስመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ያጸንዖሙ፡ መኑ፡ ውእቱ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ናቡከደነፆር።
verses.translation: And who art thou, Achior, and the hirelings of Ephraim, that thou hast prophesied among us as to day, and hast said, that we should not make war with the people of Israel, because their God will defend them? and who is God but Nabuchodonosor?

translations.lxx: And who art thou, Achior, and the hirelings of Ephraim, that thou hast prophesied among us as to day, and hast said, that we should not make war with the people of Israel, because their God will defend them? and who is God but Nabuchodonosor?
translations.ron: "Cine eşti tu, Ahior, şi voi simbriaşii lui Amon, că faci pe proorocul la noi, aşa cum faci astăzi, şi ne îndemni să nu pornim la război împotriva neamului lui Israel, fiindcă Dumnezeul lor îi apără? Şi cine este Dumnezeu afară de Nabucodonosor? El îşi va trimite oştirea sa şi-i va nimici de pe faţa pământului, iar Dumnezeul lor nu va putea să-i scape.

verses.geez: ውእቱ፡ ይፌኑ፡ መልእክቶ፡ ወያጠፍኦሙ፡ ወይዘርዎሙ፡ እምገጸ፡ ምድር፡ ወኢያድኅኖሙ፡ አምላኮሙ፡ ወንሕነሰ፡ አግብርቲሁ፡ ለናቡከደነፆር፡ ንሴርዎሙ፡ ከመ፡ አሐዱ፡ ብእሲ፡ ወኢይትቃወምዎ፡ ለኃይለ፡ አፍራሲነ።
verses.translation: He will send his power, and will destroy them from the face of the earth, and their God shall not deliver them: but we his servants will destroy them as one man; for they are not able to sustain the power of our horses.

translations.lxx: He will send his power, and will destroy them from the face of the earth, and their God shall not deliver them: but we his servants will destroy them as one man; for they are not able to sustain the power of our horses.
translations.ron: Ci noi, robii lui, îi vom sfărâma ca pe un singur om şi nu vor putea ei să se împotrivească puterii cailor noştri,

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ቦቱ፡ ንከይዶሙ፡ ወአድባሪሆሙ፡ ይሰክሩ፡ በደሞሙ፡ ወይበዝኅ፡ አብድንቲሆሙ፡ ወደቂቆሙ፡ ኢይቀውሙ፡ በሰኰና፡ እግሮሙ፡ በቅድመ፡ ገጽነ፡ አላ፡ ጠፊአ፡ ይጠፍኡ፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ ይቤ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ናቡከደነፆር፡ እግዚላ፡ ለኵላ፡ ምድር፡ እስመ፡ ይቤ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይኩን፡ ቃሉ።
verses.translation: For with them we will tread them under foot, and their mountains shall be drunken with their blood, and their fields shall be filled with their dead bodies, and their footsteps shall not be able to stand before us, for they shall utterly perish, saith king Nabuchodonosor, lord of all the earth: for he said, None of my words shall be in vain.

translations.lxx: For with them we will tread them under foot, and their mountains shall be drunken with their blood, and their fields shall be filled with their dead bodies, and their footsteps shall not be able to stand before us, for they shall utterly perish, saith king Nabuchodonosor, lord of all the earth: for he said, None of my words shall be in vain.
translations.ron: Căci noi îi vom arde. Munţii vor se vor îmbăta de sângele lor şi câmpiile lor vor fi pline de trupurile lor. Şi ei nu se vor mai putea împotrivi nouă, ci vor fi nimiciţi cu desăvârşire, - zice regele Nabucodonosor, stăpânul lumii - căci el a zis: "Să nu rămână neîndeplinite cuvintele mele!"

verses.geez: ወአንተሰ፡ አኪዮር፡ ገባዒሁ፡ ለአሞን፡ ዘነበብከ፡ ዘንተ፡ ቃለ፡ ዮም፡ ኢትሬኢ፡ ገጽየ፡ እምዮም፡ እምይእቲ፡ ዕለት፡ በኃጢአትከ፡ እስከ፡ አመ፡ እትቤቀሎሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ወጽኡ፡ እምድረ፡ ግብፅ።
verses.translation: And thou, Achior, an hireling of Ammon, which hast spoken these words in the day of thine iniquity, shalt see my face no more from this day, until I take vengeance of this nation that came out of Egypt.

translations.lxx: And thou, Achior, an hireling of Ammon, which hast spoken these words in the day of thine iniquity, shalt see my face no more from this day, until I take vengeance of this nation that came out of Egypt.
translations.ron: Tu insă, Ahior, simbriaşul lui Amon, care ai spus astăzi astfel de cuvinte de defăimare, să nu mai vezi din ziua de azi faţa mea până ce nu mă voi răzbuna pe acest neam ieşit din Egipt.

verses.geez: ወውእተ፡ አሚረ፡ ይበውእ፡ ኃጺኖሙ፡ ለሐራየ፡ ወዘሕዝብየ፡ ውስተ፡ ገቦከ፡ ወትወድቅ፡ ምስለ፡ አብድንቲሆሙ።
verses.translation: And then shall the sword of mine army, and the multitude of them that serve me, pass through thy sides, and thou shalt fall among their slain, when I return.

translations.lxx: And then shall the sword of mine army, and the multitude of them that serve me, pass through thy sides, and thou shalt fall among their slain, when I return.
translations.ron: Atunci spada oştirii mele şi suliţa războinicilor mei te vor străpunge şi vei cădea cu ucişii lor când eu mă voi întoarce împotriva lui Israel.

verses.geez: ወሶበ፡ ገባእኩ፡ ይወስዱከ፡ አግብርትየ፡ ውስተ፡ አድባሪሆሙ፡ ወያነብሩከ፡ ውስተ፡ አሐቲ፡ እምአህጉሪሆሙ፡ እለ፡ ውስተ፡ ዓቀብ።
verses.translation: Now therefore my servants shall bring thee back into the hill country, and shall set thee in one of the cities of the passages:

translations.lxx: Now therefore my servants shall bring thee back into the hill country, and shall set thee in one of the cities of the passages:
translations.ron: Robii mei să te ducă în munte şi să te lase într-una din cetăţile de acolo.

verses.geez: ወኢይቀትሉከ፡ እስከ፡ አመ፡ እሤርዎሙ።
verses.translation: and thou shalt not perish, till thou be destroyed with them.

translations.lxx: and thou shalt not perish, till thou be destroyed with them.
translations.ron: Şi nu vei pieri fără a lua parte la ruina lor.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ትትአመን፡ በልብከ፡ ከመ፡ ኢንክሎሙ፡ ኢትወድቅ፡ ገጽከ፡ እስመ፡ አንሰ፡ ነበብኩ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይወድቅ፡ እምነ፡ ቃልየ።
verses.translation: And if thou persuade thyself in thy mind that they shall not be taken, let not thy countenance fall: I have spoken it, and none of my words shall be in vain.

translations.lxx: And if thou persuade thyself in thy mind that they shall not be taken, let not thy countenance fall: I have spoken it, and none of my words shall be in vain.
translations.ron: Dar fiindcă tu nădăjduieşti în inima ta că ei nu vor fi înfrânţi, să nu te mâhneşti, căci eu am zis şi nici unul din cuvintele mele nu va rămâne fără împlinire!"

verses.geez: ወአዘዞሙ፡ ሆሎፎርኒስ፡ ለአግብርቲሁ፡ እለ፡ ይቀውሙ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ውስተ፡ ደብተራሁ፡ ከመ፡ ይንሥእዎ፡ ለአኪዮር፡ ወይሰድዎ፡ ቤጤልዋ፡ ወያወፍይዎ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ ኪያሁ።
verses.translation: Then Holofernes commanded his servants, that waited in his tent, to take Achior, and bring him to Bethulia, and deliver him into the hands of the children of Israel.

translations.lxx: Then Holofernes commanded his servants, that waited in his tent, to take Achior, and bring him to Bethulia, and deliver him into the hands of the children of Israel.
translations.ron: Şi Olofern porunci slujitorilor săi, care erau de faţă în cortul lui, să pună mâna pe Ahior şi să-l ducă în Betulia şi să-l dea în mâinile fiilor lui Israel.

verses.geez: ወነሥእዎ፡ አግብርቲሁ፡ ወወሰድዎ፡ አፍአ፡ እምትዕይንት፡ ውስተ፡ ገዳም፡ ወሖረ፡ እምነ፡ ማዕከለ፡ ገዳም፡ ውስተ፡ አድባር፡ ወእምዝ፡ በጽሑ፡ ኀበ፡ አንቅዕት፡ ዘመትሕተ፡ ቤጤልዋ።
verses.translation: So his servants took him, and brought him out of the camp into the plain, and they went from the midst of the plain into the hill country, and came unto the fountains that were under Bethulia.

translations.lxx: So his servants took him, and brought him out of the camp into the plain, and they went from the midst of the plain into the hill country, and came unto the fountains that were under Bethulia.
translations.ron: Atunci slujitorii săi l-au luat şi l-au dus afară din tabără în şes, iar din şes l-au dus în munte şi au ajuns la izvoarele din josul Betuliei.

verses.geez: ወሶበ፡ ርእይዎሙ፡ ሰብአ፡ ይእቲ፡ ሀገር፡ ውስተ፡ ርእሰ፡ ደብር፡ ነሥኡ፡ ንዋየ፡ ሐቅሎሙ፡ ወሖሩ፡ አፍአ፡ እምነ፡ ሀገር፡ ውስተ፡ ርእሰ፡ ደብር፡ ወኵሉ፡ ሰብአ፡ ሞጸፍ፡ ዓቀቡ፡ ፍሥሐታተ፡ ወአመርግሑ፡ ዕብነ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ።
verses.translation: And when the men of the city saw them, they took up their weapons, and went out of the city to the top of the hill: and every man that used a sling kept them from coming up by casting of stones against them.

translations.lxx: And when the men of the city saw them, they took up their weapons, and went out of the city to the top of the hill: and every man that used a sling kept them from coming up by casting of stones against them.
translations.ron: Dar când i-au văzut locuitorii cetăţii pe vârful muntelui, ei şi-au luat armele şi au ieşit afară din cetate pe vârful muntelui şi toţi prăştiaşii au pus stăpânire pe urcuşul dinspre ei, aruncând pietre asupra lor,

verses.geez: ወፈትሕዎ፡ ማኅሜሁ፡ ለአኪዮር፡ ወአሠርዎ፡ ጕንደ፡ ደብር፡ ወኀደግዎ፡ ህየ፡ መትሕተ፡ ደብር፡ ግዱፈ፡ ወአተዉ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚኦሙ።
verses.translation: Nevertheless having gotten privily under the hill, they bound Achior, and cast him down, and left him at the foot of the hill, and returned to their lord.

translations.lxx: Nevertheless having gotten privily under the hill, they bound Achior, and cast him down, and left him at the foot of the hill, and returned to their lord.
translations.ron: Şi ei, ascunzându-se după munte, au legat pe Ahior, l-au lăsat la poalele muntelui şi s-au întors la stăpânul lor.

verses.geez: ወወረዱ፡ ደቂቀ፡ እሥራኤል፡ እምነ፡ አህጉሪሆሙ፡ ወሖሩ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ ወፈትሕዎ፡ ወወሰድዎ፡ ብሔረ፡ ቤጤልዋ፡ ወሤምዎ፡ ውስተ፡ መላእክተ፡ አህጉሪሆሙ።
verses.translation: But the Israelites descended from their city, and came unto him, and loosed him, and brought him into Bethulia, and presented him to the governors of the city:

translations.lxx: But the Israelites descended from their city, and came unto him, and loosed him, and brought him into Bethulia, and presented him to the governors of the city:
translations.ron: Dar fiii lui Israel s-au coborât din cetate şi s-au dus la el, l-au dezlegat şi l-au adus în Betulia şi l-au înfăţişat înaintea căpeteniilor cetăţii,

verses.geez: እለ፡ ሀለዉ፡ በኪያሆን፡ መዋዕል፡ ዖዝያስ፡ ወልደ፡ ሚካ፡ ዘእምነገደ፡ ስምዖን፡ ወክብሪስ፡ ወልደ፡ ጎቶንያል።
verses.translation: which were in those days Ozias the son of Micha, of the tribe of Simeon, and Chabris the son of Gothoniel, and Charmis the son of Melchiel.

translations.lxx: which were in those days Ozias the son of Micha, of the tribe of Simeon, and Chabris the son of Gothoniel, and Charmis the son of Melchiel.
translations.ron: Care erau în zilele acelea: Oziaş, fiul lui Miheia, din seminţia lui Simeon, şi Habriş, fiul lui Otniel, şi Harmis, fiul lui Melchiel.

verses.geez: ወጸውኡ፡ ኵሎ፡ ሊቃውንተ፡ አህጉሪሆሙ፡ ወሮጹ፡ ኵሉ፡ ወራዙቶሙ፡ ወአንስቲያሆሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ምንግላጊሆሙ፡ ወአቀምዎ፡ ለአኪዮር፡ ማእከለ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ወተስእሎ፡ ዖዝያስ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘከመ፡ ኮነ።
verses.translation: And they called together all the ancients of the city, and all their youth ran together, and their women, to the assembly, and they set Achior in the midst of all their people. Then Ozias asked him of that which was done.

translations.lxx: And they called together all the ancients of the city, and all their youth ran together, and their women, to the assembly, and they set Achior in the midst of all their people. Then Ozias asked him of that which was done.
translations.ron: Şi ei au chemat pe toţi bătrânii cetăţii şi au alergat la adunare tinerii şi femeile. Şi l-au pus pe Ahior în mijlocul întregului popor, iar Oziaş l-a întrebat despre cele întâmplate.

verses.geez: ወአውሥኦሙ፡ ወአይድኦሙ፡ ነገሮ፡ ለሆሎፎርኒስ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘከመ፡ አንገለጉ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ቃሎሙ፡ ዘከመ፡ ይቤሉ፡ በማዕከለ፡ መላእክቲሆሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ አሶር፡ ወመጠነ፡ አዕበየ፡ አፉሁ፡ ሆሎፎርኒስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ቤተ፡ እስራኤል።
verses.translation: And he answered and declared unto them the words of the council of Holofernes, and all the words that he had spoken in the midst of the princes of Assur, and whatsoever Holofernes had spoken proudly against the house of Israel.

translations.lxx: And he answered and declared unto them the words of the council of Holofernes, and all the words that he had spoken in the midst of the princes of Assur, and whatsoever Holofernes had spoken proudly against the house of Israel.
translations.ron: Atunci el le-a răspuns şi le-a făcut cunoscute planurile sfatului lui Olofern şi toate cuvintele pe care el le grăise în faţa căpeteniilor asiriene şi lăudăroşenia lui Olofern împotriva casei lui Israel.

verses.geez: ወወድቁ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ወሰገዱ፡ በገዶሙ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: Then the people fell down and worshipped God, and cried unto God, saying,

translations.lxx: Then the people fell down and worshipped God, and cried unto God, saying,
translations.ron: Atunci poporul a căzut cu faţa la pământ şi s-a închinat lui Dumnezeu şi a strigat, zicând:

verses.geez: ወጸርሑ፡ ወይቤሉ፡ እግዚኦ፡ አምላከ፡ ሰማይ፡ ርኢ፡ ትዕይርቶሙ፡ ወአስተምሕር፡ ሕማሞሙ፡ ለዘመድነ፡ ወነጽር፡ ላዕለ፡ መቅደስከ፡ በሠናይ፡ በዛቲ፡ ዕለት።
verses.translation: O Lord God of heaven, behold their pride, and pity the low estate of our nation, and look upon the face of those that are sanctified unto thee this day.

translations.lxx: O Lord God of heaven, behold their pride, and pity the low estate of our nation, and look upon the face of those that are sanctified unto thee this day.
translations.ron: Doamne, Dumnezeul cerului, caută la trufia lor şi îndură-te de umilinţa neamului acestuia şi te uită cu milostivire astăzi la faţa celor sfinţiţi ai tăi!

verses.geez: ወአስተፍሥሕዎ፡ ለአኪዮር፡ ወአእኰትዎ፡ ጥቀ።
verses.translation: And they comforted Achior, and praised him greatly.

translations.lxx: And they comforted Achior, and praised him greatly.
translations.ron: Pe urmă au mângâiat pe Ahior şi l-au lăudat foarte.

verses.geez: ወነሥኦ፡ ዖዝያስ፡ እምኀበ፡ አንገለጉ፡ ወአእተዎ፡ ቤቶ፡ ወገብረ፡ በዓለ፡ ለሊቃናት፡ ወጸውዕዎ፡ ለአምላከ፡ እስራኤል፡ ኵላ፡ ይእተ፡ ሌሊተ፡ ከመ፡ ይርድኦሙ።
verses.translation: And Ozias took him out of the assembly unto his house, and made a feast to the elders; and they called on the God of Israel all that night for help.

translations.lxx: And Ozias took him out of the assembly unto his house, and made a feast to the elders; and they called on the God of Israel all that night for help.
translations.ron: Şi Oziaş l-a luat din adunare acasă la el şi a făcut ospăţ pentru bătrâni. Şi ei au strigat pe Dumnezeul lui Israel într-ajutor toată noaptea aceea.
